_policy: Exceptions to the OWASP ZAP baseline gate (tests/attack/src/zap.test.ts). Medium and High alerts fail the run unless listed here with the ZAP plugin id, a reason of at least 20 characters and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days ahead). scripts/check-zap-allow.mjs (part of pnpm lint) rejects an entry without them, an expired one and a far one.
